graces.text: Come, Lord Jesus, be our guest, and let these gifts to us be blessed. Amen.
For what we are about to receive, may the Lord make us truly thankful. Amen.
Bless us, O Lord, and these thy gifts, which we are about to receive from thy bounty, through Christ our Lord. Amen.
Some have meat and cannot eat, and some would eat that want it; but we have meat, and we can eat, and so the Lord be thanked.
Thank you for the world so sweet, thank you for the food we eat, thank you for the birds that sing, thank you, God, for everything. Amen.

night.text: Jesus, tender Shepherd, hear me; bless thy little lamb tonight. Through the darkness be thou near me; keep me safe till morning light.
Angel of God, my guardian dear, to whom God's love commits me here, ever this day be at my side, to light and guard, to rule and guide. Amen.
Now I lay me down to sleep, I pray the Lord my soul to keep. Guide me safely through the night, and wake me with the morning light. Amen.
night.ref: Traditional, with a gentler ending used by many families

night.text: Matthew, Mark, Luke and John, bless the bed that I lie on. Four corners to my bed, four angels round my head. Amen.
Müde bin ich, geh zur Ruh, schließe beide Äuglein zu; Vater, lass die Augen dein über meinem Bettlein sein.
The Lord bless you, and keep you. The Lord make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you. The Lord lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.
night.ref: Numbers 6:24–26 · a blessing to say over your child
